- Compute source HBP SHA and tiled-2MiB payload/256 SHA without executing author producer, verify artifact hashes and all reporter fields against independently fetched GitHub run/job/merge ancestry and job UTC timeline. One job per OS/Python ×4; fifth full byte equality.

The emitter code is unchanged; the checked-out git HEAD must actually be the historical PR synthetic merge (HEAD^2 = PR head). Emulating a CI event is not a hardware-attested custodian: it tests the validator's logic, not the authenticity of a different host.
